verdict.rationale: Pipecat supports telephony transports and carrier webhooks for inbound calls, and Pipecat Cloud advertises unlimited concurrency. Nothing in the evidence documents batch outbound dialing, campaign management, call scheduling, or per-campaign throughput or pacing controls. Platform concurrency is an adjacent capacity feature, not a campaign throughput control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls
